acceptanceCriteria: Every command sharing the parser either honours or refuses --require-clean with a typed error; a test enumerates them.
body:
Source: codex/w5-impact lane, GitHub #783.

Observed: commands sharing the impact argument parser, e.g. `feature`, accept --require-clean and silently ignore it. Expected: refuse as `prove` now does. Audit all sharing commands.
